config.command: Command used to start the internal DSH background service.
config.url: Address of the external DSH service, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3080. When set, the extension connects to the external DSH service, and all options related to the internal DSH background stop applying.
config.autoStart: When VS Code starts, the internal DSH background service is started automatically with the command from the Command setting.
config.supervisorIdleSec: How many seconds the internal DSH background waits before shutting down automatically after the last VS Code window closes. Recommended: no less than 10 seconds. This option has no effect when an external Url is configured.
config.diffLayout: How edit tool calls render their change: single column or side-by-side.
config.diffLayout.auto: Adaptive: single column in a narrow panel, side-by-side when wide.
config.language: Language of the chat UI. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.fontSize: Font size of the chat UI in integer pixels (>= 8). `0` follows the VS Code font size.
config.questionBatch: How many questions of one questionnaire to show at once. A questionnaire with more questions than this is asked one question at a time. `0` always shows every question at once.
